nodes.label: Artifact context/rules vs output separation rule
nodes.rationale: `context` and `rules` returned by `openspec instructions` are constraints for the agent, never content to copy into the artifact file itself — prevents leaking prompt-level guidance into proposal/spec/design/task files.
nodes.norm_label: artifact context/rules vs output separation rule

nodes.label: Delta spec intelligent merge
nodes.rationale: Sync is agent-driven rather than programmatic so a delta spec can add a single scenario without copying the entire requirement — the delta represents intent, not a wholesale replacement, and merging must be idempotent.

nodes.label: Bulk archive spec conflict resolution
nodes.rationale: When 2+ selected changes have delta specs touching the same capability, resolve by checking the codebase for actual implementation evidence: only-one-implemented syncs that one, both-implemented applies in chronological order, neither-implemented skips sync and warns.

nodes.label: OpenSpec store selection convention
nodes.rationale: A store is a standalone OpenSpec repo registered on the machine; commands that read/write specs and changes must pass --store <id> once one is named, so multi-repo/multi-store usage stays consistent across every opsx command.
